newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn steers steady on dressed basis - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn steers steady on dressed basis - USDA.

text.p: Live sales of slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Trade fairly slow. Demand and seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales
Carcass Basis (weight only) - Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a lightly tested trade.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs $103.50
Holstein: (weight only) - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1175 lbs few 103.50.
